snippet.title: Less Miserables - Overly Dramatic Teaser Trailer 2026
snippet.description:
A point-and-click parody adventure game, loosely based on Les Miserables by Victor Hugo. Fully hand drawn, and with live voice acting. Follow our Kickstarter!
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/collegefungames/less-misearbles-a-point-and-click-parody-of-les-miserables

Coming end 2026 for Windows, Linux and iOS 
https://www.lessmiserables.com

Music by the amazing Anthony Lo Re and Myu-Chan:
https://www.youtube.com/@AnthonyLoReMusic
https://www.youtube.com/@Myu-Chan
